_about: Every decision the pipeline makes. Change a value here and rerun; never fix a chapter by hand between steps. See README.md.
_exclude: File-name patterns left out of a run: compiled whole-report copies repeat the chapters.
_keep_toc: Front matter files keep their table of contents and lists of tables/figures; every other chapter loses them (step 02).
_word_step_timeout_minutes: Longest a Word step (03, 11, 12, 13) may take before its hidden Word is ended and the run stops.

style_map._about: Author style id -> template style id, applied by the strip step.

_group_row_fill: Fill for full-width group-label rows inside tables. CCD3E4 is the theme's light blue, one step darker than HM-Data's E6E9F2 banding. Use 'auto' for bold only, no fill.

accent_bar._about: Caption pattern -> bar color. First match wins. Unmatched tables get 'color'.
